title: The Magi
lead: The magi of Matthew 2, learned men from the east who followed a star to Bethlehem to honor the newborn king of the Jews. Matthew does not say how many there were or call them kings; later Christian tradition made them three kings with names. The Septuagint uses the same word, magoi, for the dream-interpreters of Babylon in Daniel 2:2, 2:10 and 5:7, and readers have long linked their star with Balaam's "star out of Jacob" (Numbers 24:17).
